controls.label: Slide library
controls.tip: BwB slides ready to use: title, agenda, divider, key figures, process, matrix, timeline, team and more.

controls.label: Agenda
controls.tip: An agenda slide built from the deck's sections, and trackers that show each slide's section.

items.label: Insert agenda slide
items.tip: Adds an agenda slide listing the deck's sections, after the current slide.

items.label: Add section trackers
items.tip: Adds a tracker to the top of every slide, with its section highlighted.

items.label: Update trackers
items.tip: Refreshes every tracker after sections change.

items.label: Remove trackers
items.tip: Removes the trackers from every slide.

items.label: Start a section here
items.tip: Marks the current slide as the start of a section, named after its title.

controls.label: Storyline
controls.tip: Every slide title in order, to read the storyline, jump to a slide or make an executive summary.

controls.label: Sticker
controls.tip: A status label at the top right of the slide, such as Draft or For discussion.

items.label: Draft
items.tip: DRAFT on the selected slides.

items.label: For discussion
items.tip: FOR DISCUSSION on the selected slides.

items.label: Preliminary
items.tip: PRELIMINARY on the selected slides.

items.label: Illustrative
items.tip: ILLUSTRATIVE on the selected slides.

items.label: Confidential
items.tip: CONFIDENTIAL on the selected slides.

items.label: Not for distribution
items.tip: NOT FOR DISTRIBUTION on the selected slides.

items.label: Remove all stickers
items.tip: Removes stickers from every slide.

controls.label: Align
controls.tip: Lines up the selected shapes with each other. With one shape selected, lines it up with the slide margins.

items.label: Left edges
items.tip: Lines up the left edges.

items.label: Centres
items.tip: Lines up the centres, left to right.

items.label: Right edges
items.tip: Lines up the right edges.

items.label: Top edges
items.tip: Lines up the top edges.

items.label: Middles
items.tip: Lines up the middles, top to bottom.

items.label: Bottom edges
items.tip: Lines up the bottom edges.

controls.label: Align to slide
controls.tip: Places the selection on the slide: centred, or against the BwB margins.

items.label: Centre on the slide
items.tip: Centres the selection, as a group, left to right on the slide.

items.label: Middle of the slide
items.tip: Centres the selection, as a group, top to bottom on the slide.

items.label: Left margin
items.tip: Moves the selection to the left margin.

items.label: Right margin
items.tip: Moves the selection to the right margin.

items.label: Top of the content area
items.tip: Moves the selection to the top of the content area, under the title.

items.label: Bottom margin
items.tip: Moves the selection to the bottom margin, above the source line.

controls.label: Distribute
controls.tip: Equal gaps between the selected shapes, within the selection or across the margins, or tidy them into rows and columns.

items.label: Horizontally, equal gaps
items.tip: Equal gaps left to right, keeping the outer shapes where they are.

items.label: Vertically, equal gaps
items.tip: Equal gaps top to bottom, keeping the outer shapes where they are.

items.label: Across the margins
items.tip: Spreads the shapes from the left margin to the right margin with equal gaps.

items.label: Down the content area
items.tip: Spreads the shapes over the content area, top to bottom, with equal gaps.

items.label: Tidy up into rows and columns
items.tip: Finds the rows and columns in a rough layout and lines them up with equal gaps.

controls.label: Same size
controls.tip: Gives the selected shapes the width, height or size of the anchor shape (the first selected, or the one you set in the pane).

items.label: Same width
items.tip: Every shape gets the anchor's width.

items.label: Same height
items.tip: Every shape gets the anchor's height.

items.label: Same width and height
items.tip: Every shape gets the anchor's width and height.

controls.label: Position
controls.tip: Swap, stack, snap to the BwB grid, change the order and group.

items.label: Swap two shapes
items.tip: Swaps the positions of two selected shapes.

items.label: Stack side by side
items.tip: Butts the shapes together left to right, with no gaps.

items.label: Stack top to bottom
items.tip: Butts the shapes together top to bottom, with no gaps.

items.label: Snap to the BwB grid
items.tip: Moves the edges of each shape to the nearest column of the BwB 12-column grid.

items.label: Bring to front
items.tip: Brings the selection in front of everything else.

items.label: Send to back
items.tip: Sends the selection behind everything else.

items.label: Group
items.tip: Groups the selected shapes.

items.label: Ungroup
items.tip: Ungroups the selected group.

controls.label: Arrange tools
controls.tip: Every alignment tool in the pane: choose what to align to, exact gaps, sizes and positions in centimetres, grids and the anchor shape.

controls.label: Elements
controls.tip: BwB slide elements: callouts, key figures, quotes, process flows, matrices, timelines and source lines.

items.label: Callout
items.tip: An off-white box with a green bar, a title and a message.

items.label: Key figures
items.tip: Three headline numbers on a navy panel, the first in lime.

items.label: Quote
items.tip: A quotation in Candara italic with a lime bar.

items.label: Process, three steps
items.tip: Three chevrons across the content area, ready to label.

items.label: Two-by-two matrix
items.tip: Four quadrants with axis labels.

items.label: Timeline
items.tip: A line with four milestones to label.

items.label: Numbered markers
items.tip: Navy circles numbered 1 to 4.

items.label: Source line
items.tip: A source line in 8 pt charcoal at the bottom left of the slide.

items.label: BwB table
items.tip: A four-by-four table with a navy header row.

controls.label: Harvey balls
controls.tip: Harvey balls to score options, in navy.

items.label: Empty
items.tip: 0 per cent.

items.label: Quarter
items.tip: 25 per cent.

items.label: Half
items.tip: 50 per cent.

items.label: Three quarters
items.tip: 75 per cent.

items.label: Full
items.tip: 100 per cent.

controls.label: Status
controls.tip: Status marks: BwB ticks and crosses, and red, amber and green dots for trackers.

items.label: On track (tick)
items.tip: A green circled tick.

items.label: At risk
items.tip: A charcoal circled exclamation mark.

items.label: Off track (cross)
items.tip: A charcoal circled cross.

items.label: Green dot
items.tip: A green status dot.

items.label: Amber dot
items.tip: An amber status dot, outside the BwB palette: for trackers only.

items.label: Red dot
items.tip: A red status dot, outside the BwB palette: for trackers only.

controls.label: Icons
controls.tip: Search 1,866 Lucide icons, the set BwB uses, and insert them as recolourable shapes.

controls.label: Photos
controls.tip: The BwB photo library: sectors, themes, markets and the team.

controls.label: Chart
controls.tip: Build a chart in the BwB style from figures pasted from Excel.

controls.label: Deck check
controls.tip: Checks every slide for off-brand fonts and colours, small text, jumping titles, empty placeholders, stray shapes and house-style wording, with fixes.

controls.label: Review notes
controls.tip: Notes for reviewers on the slide, removed in one click before sending.

items.label: Add a review note
items.tip: Adds a navy review note at the top of the slide.

items.label: Remove all review notes
items.tip: Removes every review note from the deck.

controls.label: Clean up wording
controls.tip: Fixes house style with one right answer in the selected shapes: UK spelling, dashes, dates, currency codes and per cent.

controls.label: Colour
controls.tip: BwB colours for the selected shapes: fills, text and lines.

items.label: Fill navy
items.tip: Navy fill, white text.

items.label: Fill green
items.tip: Green fill, white text.

items.label: Fill off-white
items.tip: Off-white fill, navy text.

items.label: No fill
items.tip: Removes the fill.

items.label: Text navy
items.tip: Navy text.

items.label: Text charcoal
items.tip: Charcoal text, for notes and sources.

items.label: Text white
items.tip: White text, on navy or green only.

items.label: Light grey outline
items.tip: A thin light grey outline.

items.label: No outline
items.tip: Removes the outline.

controls.label: Text
controls.tip: BwB fonts and text boxes: titles in Candara, text in Aptos, margins and autofit.

items.label: BwB fonts
items.tip: Candara for titles, Aptos for everything else, in the selected shapes.

items.label: No text margins
items.tip: Sets the text margins of the selected shapes to zero, so text lines up with other shapes.

items.label: Standard text margins
items.tip: Sets 0.2 cm text margins on every side.

items.label: Do not autofit
items.tip: Stops PowerPoint shrinking or growing the selected text boxes.

controls.label: Brand guide
controls.tip: BwB colours, type, house style and slide rules.
